name: @oha-yachiyo/desktop-ui
description: Desktop shell and agent runtime UI for Oha-Yachiyo.
author: Oha-Yachiyo contributors

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5174 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron dist-electron/main.js"
scripts.bundle:budget: vite build --manifest manifest.json && node ../../scripts/check_frontend_bundle_budget.mjs --dist dist --manifest dist/manifest.json --mode freeze
scripts.bundle:budget:target: vite build --manifest manifest.json && node ../../scripts/check_frontend_bundle_budget.mjs --dist dist --manifest dist/manifest.json --mode target
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:cua-driver && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg
scripts.pack:mac: npm run prepare:cua-driver && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dir
